name: js-ts-code-type
body: Add code_type defaults/rules for JavaScript sources so generated and bundled output is classified (for example dist//build//out/, *.min.js, *.bundle.js, *.cjs bundles) rather than excluded — preserving the all-code-included philosophy: every file is scanned and filtered by code_type, never dropped. AC: a bundled dist/app.min.js is classified generated; an ordinary src/index.js is classified src; neither is absent from the graph.
